# Platform libGLESv2.so names our guest library does not export (yet).
# Everything here is a known gap: a plugin that imports one of these names cannot
# load under BIND_NOW. Shrink this file by implementing a name; never grow it without
# recording why in the commit that does so. Do not edit by hand.
